messages:
maria: heads-up, canary started spiking ~03:12 UTC, p95 doubled vs baseline. deploy-bot flagged it. anyone watching metrics?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary p95 > 2x baseline for route /v1/generate, sample=30m, triggered auto-rollback-threshold=false, suggesting review. link: https://telemetry/redwood/alerts/987

ken: I see it in grafana, looks correlated with longer seq lengths from a specific client cohort.

sophie: which cohort? any request examples?

maria: traced to client tag `partner-embeddings` - burst of long prompts at 03:10. Not sure if model change or input pattern.

samir: deploy-bot did not auto-roll because `safety_mode=manual` for this change window. ops decision required.

maria: ok. propose plan: 1) temporarily pin traffic for `partner-embeddings` to prior model v2.7.3, 2) run a targeted rollback if pin fails, 3) notify partner. Thoughts?

ken: +1 to targeted pin. How do we pin just that cohort? `trafficctl` supports header-match routing. snippet: 
```
trafficctl set-split --route "/v1/generate" --match "x-client-tag: partner-embeddings" --to v2.7.3
```

oncall: if pin fails, what's rollback trigger? need clear exec criteria (error surge, p95 > 2.5x sustained 5m, or >5% error-rate).

maria: agreed. set criteria: p95 > 2.5x for 5m OR 5% 5xx for 3m -> escalate execute rollback.

samir: I'll prepare the rollback command and hold the runbook. rollback command: `rbctl revert --service inference --to-version v2.7.3 --force --note "canary p95 regression"`

deploy-bot: [INFO] canary audits: rollout id r-2026-11-03-0305, model v2.8.0, subscribers affected ~1.2k requests/min. Auto-fallback disabled by prod flag.

sophie: comms: i'll draft a short note to partner ops: what happened, what we're doing, ETA 15m, will confirm after pin. cc: account team.

maria: samir please run pin now, monitor for 10m. ken/sophie watch dashboards and logs. oncall - be ready to execute `rbctl` if criteria met.

samir: running trafficctl command now. 

deploy-bot: [ACTION] traffic split applied: partner-embeddings -> v2.7.3 (100% of matched requests). change id c-8842.

ken: I see p95 dropped back to baseline in the filtered cohort. nice.

oncall: monitoring metrics, no elevated 5xx.

maria: great. sophie, send partner note now. samir please keep the pin for next 2 hours while we investigate root cause.

sophie: sent. subject: "Brief outage mitigation: pinned model for partner-embeddings" body: short summary + contact.

samir: leaving pin for 2h, will annotate rollout and file postmortem link in ticker. if anything changes, calling for manual rollback.

maria: postmortem TODOs: collect request samples, compare token-length distributions, verify kernel flags between v2.7.3 and v2.8.0, check KV cache behavior. assigning to eng-runtime.

ken: adding note: consider enabling `auto-fallback` for low-risk routes in non-change windows.

maria: agreed, but we need org-level policy change. for now closing this thread — mitigation successful, keeping pin until 05:30 UTC. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
